- **Source:** Product priority, 2026-10-26 (an outside assessment of what Phrase is worth): the question that decides everything is whether models finish real tasks with fewer tokens and attempts in Phrase than in plain C# using the same libraries, at an equal or better pass rate; nothing has measured that yet. Team plan: Decider D31 (Codex, Copilot, Grok Support-it; agy no response). Pre-registered bar: Decider D32, recorded BEFORE any result row.

- **Story:** As Riley, I want the task files in the prompt and benchmark rows that separate a real model miss from a harness fault, so that I can tell a language result from the runner, and the Grok rows that fail with no_phrase_found become meaningful.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a development task whose source is in task files, When the prompt is assembled, Then those bodies are inside the prompt (the check fails if the model must open the working tree to see them)
  2. Given a completed reply with no Phrase, When the row is stored, Then passed is false and the diagnostic is no_phrase_found; given a timeout, a non-zero exit or an empty capture, Then status is unavailable with that reason; given source the compiler accepts before the emitter exists, Then a pass is labeled parse-resolve and never specs-passed
  3. Given the Grok development tasks rerun after this change and a fixture reply that is only narration, When history is read, Then the new rows are stored, the old rows stay labeled, and the narration fixture is recorded as a failure (the check fails if the rerun or the fixture is missing)
